correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the compatibility and census over F_q, including characteristic two and n=4. Let H be the abelian codimension-one ideal and D its shift. When the coefficient A of e1 in the second generating image v is nonzero, replace u by h=u−(a/A)v within H. The middle bracket is −A Dh, and [v,[u,v]]=0 is equivalent to D²h=0. This suffices for all other relations because higher images then vanish. There are (q−1)q^n base choices of (v,a); h contributes ranks 1,2,3 with respective counts 1,q−1,q(q−1). For A=0 all pairs are permitted: if a≠0 the rank is one plus the shift-chain length of v, and if a=0 it is the ordinary pair rank in H. Adding gives every stated coefficient; raw counts for A=0 and A≠0 are q^(2n−1) and (q−1)q^(n+2), and full rank is exactly the longest shift-chain branch. Division by the leading total gives the rank-two and fixed-corank limits; the geometric series plus the rank-two atom exhausts mass, with no middle-scale residue. Checked the frozen verification code and tabulation for scope; the symbolic argument, not the prime-field cases, covers all q and n. See checks/analytic-notes.md.

value.rationale: Standard filiform Lie algebras are a natural unbounded model family. Image dimension is an intrinsic endomorphism statistic and quantifies the formerly unrepresented singular portion of the monoid. The closed law explains two qualitatively different asymptotic populations at fixed field size, not merely an isolated count or the known automorphism order.
